page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. This instance features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores, resulting in 1.0 thread per core. It is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance does not include any local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage for operating system and data volumes.

The CPU configuration lacks support for several modern instruction set extensions. Specifically, advanced vector and matrix extensions such as AVX, AVX2, AVX-512, and AMX are unavailable. Cryptographic acceleration features like AES and SHA_NI, along with integer manipulation extensions such as BMI2, ADX, and FMA, are also absent. Additionally, hardware-assisted virtualization flags and hyperthreading are not supported on this instance type.

From a resource density perspective, the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance in the general-purpose category. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without the performance variability associated with shared-core or burstable instances. Given the lack of local storage, hardware accelerators, and advanced instruction sets, this instance is suited for lightweight general-purpose workloads, basic web serving, small databases, and development environments that do not require specialized cryptographic or vector processing.
